## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior.

## Evidence and validation

List the checks run and their results. For knowledge changes, link the primary source and state retrieval date, scope and uncertainty.

## Review checklist

- [ ] No credentials, client data, raw exports or private captures are included.
- [ ] Relevant tests and source projections are updated.
- [ ] Documented, simulated and native/live evidence remain distinct.
- [ ] Any limitations or untested behavior are stated.
